source.surface: pull request Files changed tab, unified diff with an inline review comment composer open
source.attribution: Screen curated by Mobbin (https://mobbin.com). Inspected remotely through the Mobbin MCP under accessMode 'remote-mcp'. No image was downloaded, cached, embedded, or stored anywhere in this repository; every value below is our own reading of the rendered screen.

evidenceTier.rationale: Mobbin is a curated gallery of captured screens. It is not a live observation we made of a running product, and no audience outcome is attached, so it cannot be silver/M2 or gold/M3. Treat these facts as evidence that a shipped product once looked this way, not as evidence that it worked.

decisionColour.acceptControl: Start a review, and Review changes in the header
decisionColour.acceptControlTreatment: solid green fill with a white label
decisionColour.rejectControlTreatment: Cancel, set as unfilled label text; Add single comment sits between them as an outlined control with no fill
decisionColour.undecidedContainerTreatment: the diff hunk carries pale green and pale red row bands, but those bands encode added and removed CONTENT, not decision state; the review itself is undecided while they are painted
decisionColour.verdict: Green appears twice on one screen with two unrelated meanings and stays legible because the two uses are structurally different: content-green is a low-saturation band spanning a full row behind monospace text with a leading plus sign, decision-green is a saturated fill on a small control with a white label. Hue alone does not identify the decision colour; the pairing of saturation, area, and control type does.
